_readme: Assistant coverage (plan §3.4). Every table, view, granted app.* function, operator route, edge function, cron job and markdown document, with the path it reaches the owner assistant by: table_read, tool:<name>, map:<chunk kind>, index:<chunk kind>, or "excluded: <reason>". check-assistant-coverage.mjs re-derives the inventory from the code and fails on any missing or extra key. `--update` adds new keys with defaults; entries containing REVIEW must be rewritten by hand before the check passes.

tables.app.assistant_readable_columns: excluded: the assistant's own column allowlist (0109); it feeds the describe tool and table_read validation directly, so a chunk of it would only restate itself
tables.app.pin_attempts: excluded: PIN lockout counters per device (0004/0011); security telemetry, not venue knowledge — the owner sees lockouts as PIN_LOCKED on the screen
tables.app.rpc_replays: excluded: raw idempotency claim rows with request payloads (0049); the OUTCOME of every replay is readable in public.sync_replays
tables.app.secrets: excluded: HMAC and signing secrets (0009/0019); never readable by anyone but definer functions, and never sent to a model vendor
tables.app.sms_limits: excluded: OTP kill switch and send caps (phone-otp 2026-09-05); only aggregate counts reach the assistant through system_status
tables.app.sms_sends: excluded: per-phone OTP send log (phone-otp 2026-09-05); phone numbers of guests, only aggregate counts reach the assistant through system_status
